import json
import os
import shutil
import subprocess
import sys
from pathlib import Path

repo = Path.cwd()
src_pkg = repo / "src" / "do_again"
runtime_root = Path.home() / ".do_again/projects/41857a676462/runtime"
dst_pkg = runtime_root / "do_again"

if not src_pkg.is_dir():
    raise SystemExit(f"missing source package: {src_pkg}")

runtime_root.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
if dst_pkg.exists():
    shutil.rmtree(dst_pkg)
shutil.copytree(src_pkg, dst_pkg)

def info(path):
    text = path.read_text()
    return {
        "exists": path.exists(),
        "has_notify_receipts": "notify_receipts" in text,
        "has_batch_limit_20": "paths[:20]" in text,
        "has_wait_for_response_false": "wait_for_response=False" in text,
    }

daemon = dst_pkg / "service" / "daemon.py"
browser = dst_pkg / "browser" / "runtime.py"

subprocess.run([
    "python3", "-m", "py_compile",
    str(daemon),
    str(browser),
], check=True)

uid = os.getuid()
label = "io.github.tran-steven.do-again.41857a676462"
subprocess.run(
    ["launchctl", "kickstart", "-k", f"gui/{uid}/{label}"],
    check=True,
)

print(json.dumps({
    "repo_head": subprocess.check_output(["git", "rev-parse", "HEAD"], text=True).strip(),
    "runtime_root": str(runtime_root),
    "daemon": info(daemon),
    "browser": info(browser),
    "restart": "ok",
    "label": label,
}, indent=2))
